title: Manual Ghostwriter runs can complete against one digest but download a different latest digest
reasoning: The flow correctly captures the triggered digest ID and polls that exact ID, but completion then ignores it and calls the global latest-digest endpoint. If another device, schedule, or retry creates a newer completed digest before this client downloads, the UI reports the manually triggered digest as complete while downloading the wrong file. The triggered digest ID is already available, and this codebase has ID-based downloads elsewhere, so the completion path should stay keyed to the same digest.
reproduction: Trigger a manual Ghostwriter digest, then let another digest complete before this poller observes completion. When the first poller reaches the completed branch, it downloads whatever getLatestDigest returns instead of the digest ID it was polling.
recommendation: Pass the completed digest ID into the download step and download by ID. After download, sync or save the corresponding digest metadata so local history reflects the same remote digest that completed.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No owned ViewModel tests were present under app/src/test or app/src/androidTest, and the existing tests do not exercise SettingsViewModel's Ghostwriter polling/download flow.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a SettingsViewModel test with a fake GhostwriterRepository where triggerDigest returns id A, getDigestStatus(A) completes, and getLatestDigest returns digest B; assert the ViewModel downloads/saves digest A rather than B.
